name: Discover Rolf's Fate
summary: In eastern Elwynn, two Stormwind guards are missing near Stone Cairn Lake. Malakai's half-eaten remains and webbed tracks lead toward a murloc village, where the search for Rolf continues.

sections.title: A Trail of Webbed Tracks
sections.body: Guard Thomas sent patrols around eastern Elwynn Forest as threats grew, but Malakai and Rolf vanished near Stone Cairn Lake. Malakai's half-eaten remains lie by the shore. Webbed footprints pressed into the mud lead east along the water's edge, straight to a ramshackle murloc camp.

sections.title: The End of Patrol
sections.body: You follow the tracks into the heart of the coastal murloc settlement. Another corpse lies there, stripped by the creatures. An inscribed medallion hangs around the fallen soldier's neck: Footman Rolf Hartford. Neither guard survived the ambush.

faq.answer: Rolf Hartford was a Stormwind footman assigned to patrol eastern Elwynn Forest under Guard Thomas, alongside Guard Malakai. Murlocs overwhelmed and killed both guards near Stone Cairn Lake.
Rolf's corpse lies farther east along the southern shore of Stone Cairn Lake, inside a murloc village near the lake's border.

faq.q: Why were the guards out near Stone Cairn Lake?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas stationed guards along eastern Elwynn's rivers and lakes to monitor incursions from murlocs and gnolls. The understaffed patrols were vulnerable to sudden, coordinated attacks.

faq.q: How do you confirm the corpse belongs to Rolf?
faq.answer: A metal medallion hangs around the torn corpse's neck, inscribed with the name Footman Rolf Hartford.
With the fates of Malakai and Rolf confirmed, you are tasked with returning west to the bridge at Eastvale Logging Camp to report the grim news to Guard Thomas.

faq.q: Are the murlocs in Stone Cairn Lake an unusual threat?
faq.answer: Murloc activity in Elwynn has grown unusually aggressive and coordinated. Murlocs are pushing inland into Stone Cairn Lake and the rivers, threatening local trade and lone patrols alike.

angles.text: Finding Rolf reveals how exposed Stormwind's rural borders are, with garrison shortages leaving basic patrols open to deadly wild attacks.
As a warrior, you see in Rolf Hartford's body the bloody reality faced by footmen serving the realm.
